The Role
Northgate Systems has spent eight years building the infrastructure platform that runs our own products. We're now packaging pieces of it for other engineering teams to use directly. We're hiring an engineering manager to help lead that transition.

We're looking for a caring, technical engineering manager excited to build and ship iteratively, close to the teams who consume the platform. This role owns core infrastructure, developer tooling, and the internal platform's security posture.

Our stack: fully typed Python 3.12 services, TypeScript on the frontend, Terraform-managed infra deployed via ECS, Postgres, and Datadog for monitoring.

This is a remote position managing a distributed team across the United States.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead a team of engineers shipping infrastructure and developer-tooling improvements.
- Mentor engineers and help shape their career development and project fit.
- Set quarterly priorities balancing platform reliability work against new capability requests.
- Partner with security and other engineering teams on cross-cutting technical direction.
- Grow the team thoughtfully, addressing skill gaps as the platform's surface area expands.

About You
At least two years in an official engineering management role, including experience managing a distributed team, and most of the following:
- Managing engineer performance, including calibration, feedback, and performance corrections.
- Growing a team: defining hiring criteria and owning the recruiting lifecycle.
- Technical execution across teams with external dependencies.
- Diagnosing and resolving team-dynamics or morale issues.
- A strong technical background sufficient to hold your own in architecture discussions, though the role expects little day-to-day code output.

About Northgate Systems
Northgate Systems builds infrastructure tooling used by thousands of engineers across our customer base. We've raised over $140 million from a mix of enterprise and growth investors and serve customers across financial services, logistics, and healthcare.

Why Northgate
- Flexible time-off policy and all federal holidays observed.
- Competitive benefits including a wellness stipend.
- Parental leave at full pay for twelve weeks.
- 401(k) with employer match.

The base pay range target for this role is $158,000-$210,000 in most US locations, and $190,000-$230,000 in the San Francisco Bay Area. Final offer depends on experience, location, and internal equity.

Northgate Systems provides equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations are available on request during the hiring process.

Ridge Compute is a cloud infrastructure company built for large-scale AI and HPC workloads. Founded in 2019, we operate data centers supporting some of the largest model-training customers in the industry.

As a Staff Field Engineer, you'll own the technical path for our largest customers from rack design to a validated, production-ready cluster. You'll work across data center operations, networking, and product engineering to turn raw hardware into reliable, customer-ready compute.

In this role, you will:
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise customers on bare-metal compute delivery.
- Lead bring-up and acceptance of new GPU clusters, including InfiniBand fabric validation and performance benchmarking.
- Define operating models for customer bare-metal fleets: break-fix, network, and firmware management.
- Partner with data center operations and networking teams to align hardware readiness with customer go-live timelines.
- Review customer-facing technical contract terms including SLAs and support boundaries.
- Represent Ridge Compute at industry conferences, with occasional travel required.

- 7+ years as a field engineer, solutions architect, or infrastructure engineer in cloud or HPC environments.
- Deep expertise with rack-scale GPU hardware, high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand, NVLink), and firmware/BMC layers.
- Expert-level Linux administration and strong networking fundamentals.
- Hands-on experience bringing up and validating large GPU clusters, integrating with Kubernetes or Slurm.

Preferred
- Experience with Python or Ansible for provisioning automation.
- Experience in security-sensitive or air-gapped customer environments.

Why Ridge Compute
We're in a stage of rapid growth, and we care about how we build and how we work together. We support independent thinking and provide real opportunities to shape the roadmap.

The base salary range for this role is $175,000-$240,000. Final offer depends on experience, skills, and location. Total rewards also include a discretionary bonus and equity.
